1. (Currently amended) Apparatus for inspection, comprising: an imaging assembly, comprising a plurality of cameras, which are mounted in different, respective locations in the imaging assembly and are configured to capture respective images of a sample; a motion assembly, which is configured to move at least one of the imaging assembly and the sample so as to cause the imaging assembly to scan the sample with a scan accuracy that is limited by a predetermined position tolerance; and an image processor, which is coupled to receive and process the images captured by the cameras so as to locate a defect in the sample with a position accuracy that is finer than the position tolerance, __wherein the image processor is configured to register the respective images with one another using regions of overlap between neighboring images and to compute relative offsets between the neighboring images that vary within the position tolerance__.

2. (Previously presented)

3. (Previously presented)

4. (Currently amended) The apparatus according to claim 1, wherein the images comprise pixels having a pitch, and wherein the image processor is configured to __compute the respective relative offsets between neighboring images with a precision that is finer than the pitch by registering the images using regions of overlap, and to combine the images using the respective relative offsets to produce a combined image having a resolution finer than the pitch__.

5. (Previously presented)

6. (Currently amended) The apparatus according to claim 1, wherein the image processor is configured to __identify a periodic pattern on the sample that appears in the respective images captured by at least one of the cameras, recover a virtual position clock responsively to the periodic pattern and to relative movement between the sample and the imaging assembly that is applied by the motion assembly, and use the virtual position clock in registering the respective images with one another__.

10. (Currently amended) The apparatus according to claim 9, wherein the plurality of the cameras comprises __at least one hundred cameras arranged in the two-dimensional array configuration__.

11. (Previously presented)

12. (Previously presented)

13. (Currently amended) The apparatus according to claim 1, wherein the motion assembly is configured to cause the imaging assembly to scan the sample in a scan direction, and wherein the apparatus comprises at least one post-inspection camera and a transverse motion unit, which is configured to shift the at least one post-inspection camera in a direction transverse to the scan direction while the imaging assembly scans the sample so that the at least one post-inspection camera images an area of the defect located by the image processor, __wherein the image processor computes an error signal indicative of a deviation of movement of the motion assembly relative to an ideal motion model and drives the at least one post-inspection camera to image the area of the defect responsively to the error signal__.
